experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Phospho-tyrosine site analyses of ALK+ and ALK- lung cancer cells. Phospho-tyrosine enrichment was done with phospho-tyrosine (P-Tyr-1000) immunoaffinity beads (Cell Signaling Technology Cat# 8803) and adapted from method previously described51. Briefly, approximately 2 x 108 cells were grown for each condition and treated with either DMSO or lorlatinib (1 uM) for 1 hr.

factor_value.value: ALK+ vs ALK-; DMSO vs lorlatinib
